description: This file defines the OrganizationsEventTypesService class, which manages organization and team event types, including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, utilizing various repositories and services.

classes.name: OrganizationsEventTypesService
classes.description: Service class for managing organization and team event types, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion operations.

methods.name: createOrganizationTeamEventType
methods.description: Creates a new event type for a team within an organization, then updates the team event type.

methods.name: getUserToCreateTeamEvent
methods.description: Prepares user data with organization admin status and profile ID for creating a team event.

methods.name: getTeamEventType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific team event type by ID.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypeBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a team event type by its slug, with optional hosts limit.

methods.name: getTeamEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all event types for a team, optionally sorted by creation date.

methods.name: getOrganizationsTeamsEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves event types associated with an organization, with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: updateOrganizationTeamEventType
methods.description: Updates an existing organization team event type.
